recOverlayMic.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when the microphone track is enabled.

recOverlayTabAudio.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when tab audio is enabled.

recOverlayWebcam.description: Recording control bar: chip shown when the webcam track is enabled.

recTitle.description: Popup: title of the record row when no session is pending.

recSub.message: Graba la pestaña con zoom automático

recCancel.description: Popup: label for the button that cancels the active recording.

recPaused.description: Popup: status label shown while a recording is paused.

recStarting.description: Popup: shown in place of the elapsed time while the recording is still opening its streams, before the clock has a zero.

recMic.description: Popup: toggle chip for the microphone track.

recTabAudio.description: Popup: toggle chip for the tab audio track.

recWebcam.description: Popup: toggle chip for the webcam track.

recWebcamNoPreview.message: Se añade al exportar. No hay vista previa mientras grabas.
recWebcamNoPreview.description: Popup: one-line disclosure shown under the Webcam toggle once it is on, before Record is pressed (task 40: the recorded page never shows a live self-view).

recWebcamDenied.message: Cámara rechazada: se graba sin ella
recWebcamDenied.description: The permission frame's own denied-state text, and the control bar's screen-reader announcement when a requested camera is declined or unavailable (task 40: the frame itself is not visible, so the bar is what a sighted user reads).

recProtected.message: No se puede grabar esta página protegida.
recProtected.description: Popup: error toast shown when the active tab can't be recorded.

popupRecordRefused.message: Grabación no permitida: abre la configuración
popupRecordRefused.description: Popup button shown after the user refuses the inline tabCapture prompt.

recFailStartUnreachable.message: La grabación no se inició: la extensión no respondió. Inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailStartUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when REC_START never reached the service worker.

recFailStartBlocked.message: La grabación no se inició: esta página no se puede grabar. Cambia a una pestaña normal e inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailStartBlocked.description: Popup: error toast when the start found no recordable tab (gone, or a protected URL).

recFailStartBusy.message: Ya hay una grabación en curso: detenla antes de iniciar otra.
recFailStartBusy.description: Popup: error toast when a start arrives while a recording is live.

recFailStartFailed.message: La grabación no se inició: no se pudo preparar la pestaña. Recárgala e inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailStartFailed.description: Popup: error toast when the worker's start threw before the engine was asked to capture.

recFailCleanup.message: Una grabación fallida sigue guardada: elimínala en la página Grabadora.
recFailCleanup.description: Popup: error toast when a failed session could not be tidied up.

recFailEngine.message: La grabación se detuvo antes de empezar: no se pudo capturar la pestaña. Inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailEngine.description: Popup: error toast when the offscreen engine failed to open its streams.

recFailEngineUnreachable.message: No se está grabando nada: la grabadora nunca se inició. Detén la grabación e inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailEngineUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when OFFSCREEN_START never reached the offscreen engine, so the badge and control bar claim a recording that is not happening.

recFailEngineStalled.message: La grabación no se inició y al detenerla no hubo respuesta. No se guardó nada; inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailEngineStalled.description: Popup: the user pressed Stop on a recording that had not begun, and the offscreen recorder never answered. The run was torn down.

popupOpenFailed.message: No se pudo abrir esa página. Inténtalo de nuevo.
popupOpenFailed.description: Popup: error toast when chrome.tabs.create fails for the setup page, the editor or the recorder.

recFailChunkWrite.message: Parte de esta grabación no se está guardando. Detenla y revisa lo que tienes en la página Grabadora.
recFailChunkWrite.description: Popup: error toast when a chunk write to IndexedDB failed mid-recording, so the file is shorter than the clock says.

recFailEventsWrite.message: La pista del cursor no se está guardando. El vídeo está bien; faltarán el zoom y los efectos de clic.
recFailEventsWrite.description: Popup: error toast when cursor-event writes to IndexedDB failed mid-recording, leaving the video intact.

recOverlayStarting.description: Recording control bar: shown in place of the timer while the recording is still opening its streams. Keep it short; it replaces a 0:00 clock.

recOverlayNotSaving.description: Recording control bar: warning chip shown when chunks are failing to reach storage. Keep it short; it sits in a row of three-letter track chips.

recOverlayCamDenied.description: Recording control bar: warning chip shown when a requested camera was declined or unavailable. Keep it short; it sits in a row of three-letter track chips.

recFailRecorderOpen.message: Tu grabación está guardada, pero la página Grabadora no se abrió. Usa «Recuperar última grabación» más abajo.
recFailRecorderOpen.description: Popup: error toast when chrome.tabs.create for the recorder page failed after a recording finished.

recFailQuery.message: No se pudo consultar el estado de la grabación: compruébalo en la página Grabadora.
recFailQuery.description: Popup: error toast when REC_QUERY threw, so "not recording" cannot be trusted.

recFailOverlayBlocked.message: Los controles de grabación no se pudieron abrir en esta página: detén la grabación desde aquí.
recFailOverlayBlocked.description: Popup: error toast when the in-page control bar could not be injected.

recFailOverlayLost.message: Los controles de grabación se perdieron en esta página: detén la grabación desde aquí.
recFailOverlayLost.description: Popup: error toast when the in-page control bar stopped reporting mid-recording.

recFailControlUnreachable.message: Eso no llegó a la grabadora: la extensión no respondió. Inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailControlUnreachable.description: Popup: error toast when stop/cancel never reached the service worker.

recFailSessionLoad.message: No se pudo abrir esa grabación: puede estar incompleta.
recFailSessionLoad.description: Recorder page: error toast when a session could not be read out of IndexedDB.

recFailSegmentSkipped.message: Parte de esta grabación no se pudo reproducir y quedó fuera de la exportación.
recFailSegmentSkipped.description: Recorder page: error toast when one or more segments were skipped during an export.

recFailExport.message: La exportación falló: no se guardó ningún archivo. Inténtalo de nuevo.
recFailExport.description: Recorder page: error toast when the export threw.

recFailSaveInterrupted.message: Error al guardar: $ERROR$. La grabación se ha conservado.
recFailSaveInterrupted.description: Recorder page: error toast when the Save dialog's download was interrupted for a reason other than the user cancelling it.

recFailSaveUnverified.message: No se pudo confirmar que el guardado terminara. La grabación se ha conservado.
recFailSaveUnverified.description: Recorder page: error toast when the download never reported a terminal state within the bounded wait.

recorderSaveCancelled.description: Recorder page: toast shown when the user dismisses the export's Save dialog.

recorderFailed.description: Recorder page: pill on a session whose recording never started.

recRecover.description: Popup: link that reopens the editor for a crashed/unfinished recording session.

recContinue.description: Popup: record row title when a continue-session is pending from the editor. Also the recorder page header button that starts a continue-session.

recAcrossSites.description: Settings: label for the row that grants recording access to all sites.

recAcrossSitesHint.message: Mantiene el cursor superpuesto cuando la pestaña cambia de sitio. Da acceso a todos los sitios.
recAcrossSitesHint.description: Settings: hint shown under the record-across-sites row.

recorderOpen.description: Recorder page: button that opens a session for playback.

recorderDelete.description: Recorder page: button that deletes a session.

recorderDeleteConfirm.description: Recorder page: armed state of the delete button, click again to confirm.

recorderEmpty.message: Aún no hay grabaciones. Graba una pestaña desde el menú de la extensión.
recorderEmpty.description: Recorder page: shown when the session list is empty.

recorderLoadingList.description: Recorder page: shown in place of the session list while it loads.

recorderSessionLoading.description: Recorder page: label on the progress bar shown while a session's chunks load.

recorderSourceTab.description: Recorder page: session list row — capture source. Every recording is a tab capture; there is no window/screen source to distinguish yet.

recorderTrackRequested.description: Recorder page: session list row — a mic/webcam track that was asked for and has some evidence (the combined recorder-#2 stream exists) but cannot be confirmed individually, since a mic-only and a webcam-only stream are indistinguishable from chunk presence alone.

recorderRecovered.description: Recorder page: pill on a session that was left mid-recording by a crash.

recorderRecordingNow.description: Recorder page: pill on the session that is being recorded right now; its Open and Delete buttons are disabled.

recContinueHint.message: Abre el menú de la extensión en la pestaña que quieras seguir grabando.
recContinueHint.description: Recorder page: info toast shown after Continue recording is clicked.

recorderAddZoom.description: Recorder page: button that adds a zoom block at the playhead.

recorderZoomBlockMany.description: Recorder page: the zoom-block count an undo/redo announcement carries, for none or several.

recorderDeleteZoom.description: Recorder page: button that removes the selected zoom block.

recorderZoomScale.description: Recorder page: label of the zoom scale segmented control.

recorderZoomTarget.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the draggable target reticle on the preview.

recorderTrimStart.description: Recorder page: aria-label of a segment's leading trim handle.

recorderTrimEnd.description: Recorder page: aria-label of a segment's trailing trim handle.

recorderTimelineAria.description: Recorder page: aria-label of the timeline region.

recorderCursorMode.description: Recorder page: label of the segmented control that merges showing the recorded cursor and drawing a ripple at every recorded click.

recorderCursorHidden.description: Recorder page: state of the cursor control that draws neither the cursor nor a click ripple.

recorderCursorShown.description: Recorder page: state of the cursor control that draws the recorded cursor path as a pointer, with no click ripple.

recorderCursorRippleOnly.description: Recorder page: state of the cursor control that draws a ripple at every recorded click, with the cursor itself hidden.

recorderVolTab.description: Recorder page: label of the tab-audio volume slider.

recorderVolMic.description: Recorder page: label of the microphone volume slider.

recorderCancelConfirm.description: Recorder page: armed state of the export Cancel button, click again to confirm.

recorderExportRemaining.description: Recorder page: wall-clock time left in an export in progress, formatted m:ss (or h:mm:ss for a long recording).

editorAnnotationCountOne.description: Editor live region: one annotation, e.g. "1 annotation".

editorAnnotationCountOther.description: Editor live region: several annotations, e.g. "3 annotations".

editorCutCountOne.description: Editor draft-restore pill: one cut, e.g. "1 cut".

editorCutCountOther.description: Editor draft-restore pill: several cuts, e.g. "3 cuts".

editorNoAnnotations.description: Editor live region: fragment used mid-sentence when a delete leaves nothing selected, e.g. "Rectangle deleted, no annotations left."

editorAnnotationFallback.description: Editor live region: generic name for an annotation type the tool list has no label for (should not normally happen).

editorAnnounceSelect.description: Editor live region: one annotation was selected.

editorAnnounceSelectMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were selected, e.g. "2 of 3 annotations selected."

editorAnnounceDeselect.description: Editor live region: the selection was cleared.

editorAnnounceAdd.description: Editor live region: a new annotation was drawn.

editorAnnounceMove.description: Editor live region: one annotation was moved.

editorAnnounceMoveMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were moved, e.g. "3 annotations moved."

editorAnnounceResize.message: Se cambió el tamaño de $LABEL$ a $W$ por $H$ píxeles.
editorAnnounceResize.description: Editor live region: one annotation was resized.

editorAnnounceResizeMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were resized, e.g. "3 annotations resized."

editorAnnounceDelete.description: Editor live region: one annotation was deleted.

editorAnnounceDeleteMany.description: Editor live region: several annotations were deleted.

editorAnnounceDuplicate.description: Editor live region: the selection was duplicated, e.g. "2 annotations duplicated."

editorAnnounceRedo.description: Editor live region: a redo step ran. Followed in code by an optional picture-size sentence and the current layer count.

editorStepImageSize.description: Editor live region: the picture changed size on an undo/redo step that re-applied or reverted a crop.

editorStepImageHeight.description: Editor live region: the picture changed height on an undo/redo step that put back or took a cut.

editorHandleTopLeft.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the top-left corner.

editorHandleTop.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the top edge.

editorHandleTopRight.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the top-right corner.

editorHandleRight.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the right edge.

editorHandleBottomRight.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the bottom-right corner.

editorHandleBottom.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the bottom edge.

editorHandleBottomLeft.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the bottom-left corner.

editorHandleLeft.description: Editor live region: the crop handle at the left edge.

editorHandleStart.description: Editor live region: the cut band's start handle.

editorHandleEnd.description: Editor live region: the cut band's end handle.

editorCropPhrase.description: Editor live region: the size and place of the crop rectangle.

editorAnnounceCropHandle.description: Editor live region: a crop handle is now active, followed by the crop's size and place.

editorAnnounceCropApplied.description: Editor live region: the crop was applied.

editorAnnounceCropCancelled.description: Editor live region: the crop was cancelled.

editorAnnounceCut.message: Banda de corte de $H$ píxeles de alto en $Y$.

editorAnnounceOutOfPicture.description: Editor live region: annotations that sat on cut rows left the picture with them.

editorAnnounceSelectedRemaining.description: Editor live region: what is still selected after a cut removed some annotations with it.

editorAnnounceCutRemoved.message: Repuestos $H$ píxeles. Imagen de $IMAGE_HEIGHT$ píxeles de alto.
editorAnnounceCutRemoved.description: Editor live region: a cut was put back into the picture.

editorAnnounceCutCancelled.description: Editor live region: the drafted cut was cancelled.

editorCanvasKeyboardHelp.message: Pulsa el corchete derecho para seleccionar la siguiente anotación y el corchete izquierdo para la anterior. Mantén Shift con cualquiera de los dos para añadir esa anotación a la selección en lugar de sustituirla. Pulsa Enter para colocar la herramienta elegida en la barra. Usa las flechas para mover la selección un píxel, Shift y una flecha para moverla diez, y Alt y una flecha para cambiar su tamaño. Pulsa Alt y D para duplicar la selección. Con un recorte abierto, las flechas lo mueven, los corchetes eligen uno de sus ocho tiradores, Alt y una flecha lo redimensionan desde ese tirador, Enter lo aplica y Esc lo cancela. Con la herramienta Cut, Enter inicia una banda a lo ancho de la imagen, las flechas arriba y abajo la mueven, Alt y una flecha cambian su tamaño, Enter la quita y Esc la cancela. Pulsa Supr con la herramienta Cut para reponer el corte más cercano.
